full_page.content:
1934, November
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5. ---
Page 262 Cont.
Nov. 7 Mr. O'Neil - Motherles Family at 5554 Lemay. ...
Aldice Holland - 40 - away from home two mo. - wife heard of accident.
7 Mrs. Jermie Hugh - 55 - cataract - glucoma, etc, etc.
8 Eva Reid - 43 - intestinal cancer - only support of aged mother - husband a convert ..... Nov. 25 reported operation yesterday. Can- cer of intestines found ... so hopeless is abandoned.
John Wyroba - 22 - deaf in one ear since 6 & totally so since twelve.
8 Cha's Sweeney - 17 - hunting ... got thorn in ankel ... seven days later took lock-jaw - phone-call last night at 10 o'cl. when doctors had given up all hope of recovery ... slept afterwards and was still sleeping at 9 a.m. when father visited him still sleep- ing ... Saturday a.m. asks for what he wants, seemingly out of im- mediate danger ... P.M. phones report "brightening up but totally deaf. Same Chas. Sweeney came to monastery To-day Dec. 8 with parents - save hearing ... O.K.
Page 263 Blank Page
Page 264 Nov. Ed. Woods - 32 - still lame in neck, hurt 12 yrs. ago playing foot- ball ....
Mrs. Amelia Coughlin - 63 - Mother of Father Cha's E. Coughlin, diabetes worries asks prayers for son - God's protection, etc.
Mrs. Frances Adrian O'Malley - 21 - ....
11 John To's Mc Laughlin - 56 - Pasidina, Calif'a - hopelessly cancer- ous .... Enrolled To-day at 2 P.M ..... 14th Phone message to sisters here in Detroit. "Very Serious." Can only Pray-hope.
Mrs. Messner - 34 - threatened-goiter.
Mr. & Mrs. Peiffer ... separated seemingly from nothing than misun- derstand .... She has sister in the convent asking .....
Sister Antonine, who had her back broken and for whom we prayed last May is again in perfect condition. Deo Gr.
